title: Plana Digital
usage: Every 'file' is relative to public/works/plana/. In Vite use `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}works/plana/${file}`. w/h are intrinsic pixel size (SVG: viewBox units). 'bg' = dominant border colour of the image (handy for letterbox/card backgrounds).
identity: v2.0 'plana digital' (browser-window sunrise symbol, Sora/Figtree/DM Mono). The old v1.0 'plana' board is only in archive/.

dotOff.role: unlit title-bar dot in the Day 1/2/3 windows (measured from manual p3)

carouselRecommendation.note: tier 'core' (8 slides, order field) tells the story: cover, symbol idea, logo forms, palette, type, website, street sign, social. 'extended' adds naming, construction, graphic elements, apparel, stationery, van and the closing slide.

flags: Mock contact data inside several images (planadigital.com, hola@planadigital.com, 600 000 000, 'Nom Cognom'): placeholders, not the real contacts. Real domain is planadigital.cat.
Example client 'Fleca Rosella' / 'Montse' and Instagram stats 48 / 1,204 / 310 are illustrative mock content, not real clients or audience numbers.
Text inside the images is Catalan/Spanish; the site UI is English, so write English captions around them.

folders.manual: 17 pages of Plana Digital brand manual v2.0 (October 2026), 1600x1000 WebP
folders.board: crops of the brand board PDF (v2.0)
folders.logo: sanitised, optimised SVG logo set + derived animatable parts
folders.web: reserved for the live-site screenshots (other agent) - not listed here

files.title: Cover
files.alt: Brand manual cover on holm-oak green: the plana digital horizontal logo, the line 'Webs llestes en 72 hores.' in wheat yellow and a large browser-window symbol with a sunrise and a cursor, cropped at the bottom-right.
files.note: Opener. Dark green, big sticker-style symbol.

files.title: The name
files.alt: Manual page 'El nombre': the words 'plana digital' set huge in Sora, with four numbered readings of the name (plana web, la Plana, pla/plana, digital), the slogan and the four personality words.

files.title: The symbol: a sunrise inside the browser
files.alt: Manual page 'El símbolo' on wheat yellow: the headline 'Un amanecer dentro del navegador.' beside the large symbol, and three small windows for Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3 in which the sun rises and the three title-bar dots light up one by one.
files.note: Best story page: explains the logo idea (sunrise = business coming online; 3 dots = 3 days = 72 h).

files.title: Construction of the symbol
files.alt: Technical drawing of the symbol on a 124 by 100 unit grid with annotated frame stroke 7.5, corner radius 18, bar at 24, horizon at 74, sun radius 27 and a solid volume offset of 8 and 9, plus the two support colours.
files.note: Craft detail; strong for a design audience.

files.title: Logotype anatomy and clear space
files.alt: Manual page 'Logotipo principal' showing the horizontal logo with baseline, x-height, ascender and descender guides and the clear-space box equal to the height of the letter a.

files.title: Logo versions
files.alt: Four full-height colour columns showing the logo versions: horizontal on paper, vertical on wheat yellow, symbol alone on holm-oak green and the round seal on poppy red.
files.note: Very visual: all four brand colours + all four logo forms.

files.title: Colour application and misuse
files.alt: Six logo-on-colour tiles (paper, holm-oak, poppy, wheat, night, one ink on white) and four crossed-out misuse examples: do not distort, do not change the colours, do not change the order, do not use on competing backgrounds.

files.title: Colour palette
files.alt: Manual page 'Los colores del Vallès en junio.' with five large swatches, Poppy E5502F, Wheat F2CF6B, Holm oak 1E4634, Paper F7F2E8 and Night 18181B, each with RGB, CMYK and a usage note, and a bar showing the approximate proportion of use.
files.note: Hex/RGB/CMYK in the image are the source of truth.

files.title: Typography
files.alt: Holm-oak green page with three giant 'Aa' specimens: Sora ExtraBold for headlines and the logotype, Figtree Regular to Bold for text, DM Mono Medium for labels and data.

files.title: Graphic elements and tone of voice
files.alt: Left: a poppy '72 h' sticker, the round seal, the three-window sequence and the app icon. Right: the voice rule 'Como en el mostrador, no como en un folleto' with three yes/no phrase pairs.
files.note: Sticker finish = thick outline + solid shadow in Night.

files.title: Application: website
files.alt: A laptop and a phone on a holm-oak green and sand backdrop showing the Plana Digital website: Catalan headline 'La web del teu negoci, llesta en 72 hores.', a green three-days card and a fixed-price footer strip.
files.note: Shows the site layout Pau designed (mockup).
